deviation: The draft clause is one-way: it binds only Arcadia (the Customer) and gives Arcadia no matching protection for its own personnel. It also replaces the fixed 12-month tail with an undefined "reasonable period", and carves out general advertising. That is less certain and less favourable than the mutual 12-month standard, and no fallback is available.
suggested_text: 19.5 Non-Solicitation. Neither party shall solicit for employment the other party's personnel involved in the Services during the term and for 12 months afterwards.
